name: Battle of Dandanaqan
summary: The Seljuk Turks defeat the Ghaznavid Sultan Mas'ud I at Dandanaqan in Khorasan (modern Turkmenistan), ending Ghaznavid control over the region. The battle marks the emergence of the Seljuks as an independent imperial power; within fifteen years they control all of Persia, Iraq, and Baghdad. The defeated Ghaznavids retreat permanently to their eastern territories around Lahore.

_quarry.structural_significance: Birth of the Seljuk Empire as a major power; beginning of Turkic political dominance over the Islamic heartland
